title: Consensus Round
description: Written by the orchestrator after each cross-review round. Records the state of peer consensus — which workers passed, which have outstanding issues, and whether consensus was reached. Domain-agnostic.

outstandingIssues.description: Issues from FAIL reviews that remain unresolved.

consensusReached.description: True when all workers have all-peers-passed and zero outstanding issues.

nextAction.description: continue-remediation = at least one worker has unresolved issues. proceed-to-ratification = peer consensus achieved, orchestrator should ratify.
